tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa'i cho ga dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba'i rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa ye/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /bstan srung rnam mang thos sras la btud nas/ /de nyid mnyes byed mchod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'dir spel lo/ /'dir rgyal chen rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa'i cho ga dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba'i rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba nyams su len pa la/ rten gyi gang zag dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ phyag na rdo rje dang chos skyong chen po'i rjes gnang thob pa/ khyad par gyi dam tshig stod g.yog sngon po bgo ba/ lung thang gi phreng ba bgrang ba/ rta'i sha mi bza' ba/ yugs sa mos chag tshang byas pa'i zas mi bza' ba/ re ba nag po'i stan la mi 'dug pa/ snod kha chag tu zas mi bza' ba/ mi ro rta ro la mi 'ju ba ste dam tshig bdun dang ldan pa/ phyi rten rta sngon po dngos sam gzugs/ nang rten cho ga dang mthun par byas pa'i bris sku/ gsang rten bshad pa ltar byas pa'i bai yig sngags dang bcas pa'i ga'u ste rten gsum tshang bar btsugs shing 'di bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas yar ngo'i gza' skar bzang po la gtsang zhing dben pa'i gnas su yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku dgram/ grub na maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa la gtso 'khor dgu'i tshom bu dgod/ yi dam chos skyong / rta bdag brgyad/ 'khor spyi rnams la che zhing bzang ba'i gtor ma re re'am/ ma 'byor na yi dam chos skyong spyi la re re/ bskang bshag la dgos pa'i khang bzang gi dbyibs su byas pa'i bskang gtor che ba phyag len bzhin dang / chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang / dung chos su dri bzang sbyar ba'i chu 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa/ spyan gzigs dang /

rdo rje dril bu/ rol mo'i bye brag la sogs pa ci 'byor pa dang / rmig zlum dang mdzo rtol gyi sha dang / chang ma gtogs pa'i tshogs rdzas ci 'byor pa bshams la/ yo byad rnams la dri bzang gi chu gtor te/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bha was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ ces dang so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇam̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ar+gham̐/ pād+yaṃ/ āṃ tsa ma nam̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+da'i mthar rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥzhes pas phyag bya/ puṣ+pe/ sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyi rgyun bshag bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shu n+ya tas sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing /

dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yog dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can nas dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la thim par bsam/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ de rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim par bsam zhing / oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces lung thang gi phreng ba la ci nus bgrangs/ mthar oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sngon du 'gro ba'i/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang na/ /gdug pa can rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ de nas rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis 'khyil ba'i sngags dang dri bzang gi chus phyogs kun tu bsang gtor byas la/

a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las mdun du bh+rum̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bcas pa/ 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i dbus su khang pa brtsegs ma dgu yod pa/ dbus ma'i pho brang gsum brtsegs su gnas pa'i rtse mor nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ logs rnams su drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing / mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'i ka ba gnyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgyas phyogs re rer brgyan pa/ gter gyi khang pa bco lnga bco lngas spras pa/ phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bum pa bzang po brgyad/ dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad/ rin po che'i ljon shing brgyad/ rdzing bu bzang po ljon shing dang me tog gis brgyan pa brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba brgyad rnams spel mar gnas pa/ phyi nas rin po che'i rwa ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba/ pho brang dbus ma'i nang du hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bai yig gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bai yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa dgos 'dod thams cad stsol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhal las rin po che'i char 'bebs shing / skye dgu thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las sgrol ba/ dbu la rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol zhing / sku la rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/

phrag gong g.yas g.yon gnyis la nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa/ seng ge dkar po nyal stabs su gnas te de nyid la gdong blta ba'i steng na sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa'o/ /phyogs mtshams kyi khang brtsegs rnams su pad+ma'i gdan re re'i steng du/ shar du rmugs 'dzin ser po g.yas rin po che/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po rin po che'i bum pa/ nub tu nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu/ byang du ku bhe ra nag po ral gri/ shar lhor yang dag shes ser po gser gri/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po rin po che'i mdung / nub byang du lnga brtsen ser skya khang brtsegs/ byang shar du 'jam po 'khyil ba dkar po gri phub 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan dang / g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ rang rang gi mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rta la chibs pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid la mi sdug pa'i cha byad can no/ /'khor sa bar pa la gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs rnams dang / 'khor sa tha ma la sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa lha ma srin sde brgyad dang / gnod sbyin dang srin po'i tshogs mi sdug cing brjid la rngam pa/ phyag g.yas na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin zhing / g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sku mdog mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa sprin phung 'thib pa bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ gzhan yang rnam sras dkar po tshe 'phel/ rnam sras mthing kha yab yum gtso 'khor/ mgon po gar mkhan mchog zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa lha brgyad/ gar mkhan mchog dmar smug yab yum/ rnam sras dregs byed seng bzhon klu brgyad kyis bskor ba/ bzhon pa spangs pa'i dregs byed 'khor klu brgyad dang bcas pa/ rnam sras drag po yang gsang srin po bzhis bskor/

rnam sras mthing nag bdud mo bzhis bskor/ ma mo ltar bsgrub pa lha dgu/ rnam sras mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa/ rnam sras dmar po las mkhan mdung dmar can dang bcas pa/ gsang ba gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa lha bcu gsum/ rnam sras ljang yul mar grags pa gser chen lha dgu/ rnam sras ljang ser be con can te rnam sras kyi rigs mi 'dra ba gtso 'khor de thams cad kyang sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa dbyar gyi na bun chen po 'thib pa lta bur gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ man ngag las byung ba'i spos sam/ med na 'bras phye dang spos dkar bsres pa bsreg cing rol mo dang bcas te/ rang phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi sna la 'dod rgyal dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa spros pas/ des byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te mdun du bskyed pa'i rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ rgyal po 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya'am/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas shing / spro na rnga brdungs dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mgon po 'dir rol mo dkar dung 'dra/ rkang gling sogs dang bcas/ rdo rje phur pa'i gser skyems kyi mgo ltar rol mo bcams la nyis brdeg lan can brdeg la srin thung ma'i/ gdangs dang bcas la mdzad/ kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying bas/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun tshig snga ma la gdangs srin thung ma ring tsam dang / phyi ma gnyis la thung ba rol mo nyis brdeg lan can re dang bcas pa mdzad/ spyod cing / /gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod/ /thugs dam zhal bzhes de dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang /

/sems can kun la phan slad du/ /ngal gsos rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol/ / 'dir rol mo nyis brdeg dang chems brdungs/ de nas che ba gnyis brdeg la bzhag oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wa ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bai swāhā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod/ bai ring po brjid dang ldan pa mig btsum sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi yun tsam brjod pas rgyal po'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab ma re re la bai bzhi bzhi bsam zhing / dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i thugs kar 'od zer gyi lcags kyus dbyer med du byas par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la dpon slob mang po yod na skabs 'dir bai bsgrigs 'don sum cu rtsa grangs sam lnga bcu rtsa grangs sogs mdzad/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes pas rin po che'i cod pan gyi dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas mchod pa rnams rgyas par 'bul ba ni/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ nyer spyod/ rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga/ rin chen bdun/ bkra shis brgyad la sogs pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rang bzhin stong nyid/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ rgya khyon nam mkha' gang ba/ byed las rgyal chen lhag par mnyes nas dngos grub kyi char chen po 'bebs par gyur cig oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya a warta ya ho/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rnga brdungs gdangs dang bcas pas/

mchod pa bsang gtor nas rol mo'i bar gyi tshigs bcad 'di rnams la rdo rje phur pa'i sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung bcug la/ sngags rnams la yang rnga brdungs dang bcas bsgrigs 'don dang / mtshams rnams su rol mo gsum brdeg lan can re mdzad/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen bsang gtor mchod sprin 'di/ /bstan srung rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na/ /dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wa ra prok+ṣa ṇam̐ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas legs 'ongs pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen yon chab mchod sprin 'di/ /bstan srung rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na/ /dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wa ra ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen rang bzhin zhabs bsil 'di/ /bstan srung rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na/ /dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen rang bzhin zhal bsil 'di/ /bstan srung rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na/ /dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra āñca ma nam̐ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen me tog dam pa 'di/ /bstan srung rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na/ /dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wa ra puṣ+pe pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen bdug spos dam pa 'di/ /bstan srung rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na/ /dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du rtsol/

/oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wa ra dhuṣ+pe pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen snang gsal dam pa 'di/ /bstan srung rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na/ /dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wa ra a lo ke pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen dri mchog dam pa 'di/ /bstan srung rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na/ /dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wa ra gan+dhe pra tits+tsha swāhā/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen zhal zas dam pa 'di/ /bstan srung rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na/ /dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wa ra nai wi te pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa'i/ /mkha' khyab rin chen sil snyan dam pa 'di/ /bstan srung rin chen mang la bdag 'bul na/ /dngos grub rin chen char rgyun myur du stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ra bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wa ra shap+da pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ spro na yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'di la ma lus sems can ma'i gdangs thung tal mar mdzad/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan/ /gser ri'i lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing / /sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi ldan pa/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' khyab yid 'ong lha rdzas dngos kun dang / /bka' 'bangs bran slad rang lus nyer gtogs bcas/ /ma chags mi zhum zab cing rgya che'i phyir/ /dgongs chen bsgrub phyir dge tshogs rgya mtshos mchod/ /rang gis rgyu sngon ma bsags 'bras 'dod dang / /don med don log cung zad don phyir ni/ /ha cang 'dod ches bskyed dang chog ma shes/

/bsam sbyor nongs pa gang mchis mthol lo bshag /lha klu mi rnams 'jigs dang phongs pa las/ /myur skyobs 'jig rten skyong rgyal 'jig rten las/ /kun sgrol kun nas phan dang bde ster ba/ /'phrin las rgyun mi chad la rjes yi rang / /sna tshogs ya nga 'jigs dang mgon med dang / /sdig sdug brel 'phongs brgyas gzir skal ngan rnams/ /dbugs dbyung slad du thugs gsung sku dang 'od/ /nyi zla rgyal mtshan ne'u le rnam rol bskul/ /khyod sku khro dang 'dzum dang brjid mdzes 'gying / /sgeg dul brtan 'jigs dpa' bo'i gar dgu yis/ /mi bsrun tshar gcod skal ldan rjes gzung phyir/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/ /de ltar 'gro skyob khyed la 'gro bde'i slad/ /lha mchog lhag pa'i lhar bzung bsnyen bkur bas/ /bdag sogs mgon med mgon mdzod rtag tu yang / /shes rab thugs rjes mi bsnyel mi gtong shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i rnga brdungs skabs 'dir rol mo nyis brdeg lan can dang / tshigs bcad phyi ma rnams la mgon po'i bdud rtsi lnga mchod gyi g.yang gzhi bla bre'i 'dur gdangs rol mo gsum brdeg lan can mdzad/ gdangs dang bcas pas/ sh+lau ka gcig la mgon po'i srin gzugs ma/ gdangs ring dang rol mo nyis brdeg lan can byed/ hūm̐ mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyed la bstod/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang / /khyad par las bsgrub gnod sbyin brgyad/ /nor ster ba yi klu chen brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgra bgegs ma lus gzhom pa dang / /'byor ba'i longs spyod phun tshogs shing / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /gzhan don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces bstod/

rgyal po'i thugs kha'i pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje ser po'i lte bar bai yig gser gyi mdog can snying po dang gzungs kyi phreng bas bskor ba dang / 'khor rnams kyi thugs khar yang zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa'i mthar so so'i sngags kyis bskor ba bsam/ rang gi lce rdo rje'i sbu gur bsam la/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe thugs ka'i sa bon dang sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse la mchod pa sna tshogs spros te rgyal po 'khor bcas mchod pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po spros te 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal 'byor/ gzi brjid/ longs spyod la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas bdag gi snying khar thim par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces phyag na rdo rje'i sngags ci rigs shig sngon du bzlas la/ de nas rgyal po'i sngags bzla'o/ /gzungs 'di rnams bsgrigs 'don tshar gsum gsum mdzad/ tad+ya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e h+ye hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba ar+tha me sā dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ su dha ne/ su ra ṇi/ su ma ti/ su pu ṣe/ hi li mi li swāhā/ snying po ni/ oṃ bai shrā wa ṇa ya swāhā/ zhes pa ste bsnyen pa'i tshad ni rnam sras bskang gso'i tshe brgya rtsa gcig mdzad/ bzhi 'bum mo/ /'khor gyi sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha lā ya swāhā/ 'di man dpon slob mang po yod na bsgrigs 'don tshar gsum re thams cad la mdzad/

oṃ pūr+ṇa bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swāhā/ oṃ sam̐ pra dz+nyā na ya swāhā/ oṃ gu has+d+yā nā ya swāhā/ oṃ pañci kā ya swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa la ye swāhā/ zhes pa rnam sras gser can gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags dang / oṃ bh+rum̐ ṇi a yu ṣe hūm̐/ zhes pa dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sngags dang / oṃ bai phu ta sa ro bi shwa ra bi dza ye swāhā/ zhes snying po/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes nye snying / oṃ mahā pad+ma ku la dha ri shaṅka ba su rat+na k+ṣa te na ga sarba ma ni ma nu sma ra swāhā/ zhes yum gyi snying po dang / oṃ ba su ko ṣa ba ra ma ni dh+rig ya ba su dha ri ni swāhā/ oṃ ba su bha dra pur+ṇa bha dra sam̐ bhu ta dzha bha wa3 kan+ta raṣawe te/ bha wa shwa na dha ra swāhā/ oṃ ar+ya a gu li a de wa li/ phu na ga mi/ ya yak+ṣa li/ ra rak+ṣa li/ ya ya ma li/ na ma sarba sid+dhi ku ru swāhā/ rnam sras mthing kha yab yum gtso 'khor gyi sngags dang / oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ mgon po gar mkhan mchog gi sngags dang / na mo bai shra ma ṇa ye na thā ku bhe ra mahā bha ga bh+ya kri ta/ bhi na bha na/ dh+yi ma na ba si ti swāhā/ oṃ mahā pad+ma ku la dha ri shuṅka/ bha su rat+na k+ṣa te na ga sarba ma ṇi/ ma nu sma ra swāhā/ gar mkhan mchog dmar smug yab yum gyi sngags dang / oṃ ni lam̐ bha ra dha ra badz+ra pa ṇi mahā yak+ṣa ra dza ku be ra bi ru ra ga sid+dhi me pra yañca hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rnam sras dregs byed seng bzhon klu brgyad kyi sngags dang / oṃ ni lam̐ bha ra dha ra badz+ra pa ṇi mahā yak+ṣa ra dza ku be ra/ bi ru ṭa ka sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rnam sras dregs byed bzhon pa spangs pa'i sngags dang / oṃ bai shra ma ṇa tri pra ra pra ya hūm̐/ 'bar ba 'bar ba hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rnam sras drag po yang gsang srin po bzhis bskor ba'i sngags dang / hūm̐ bai traka rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ

rnam sras mthing nag bdud mo bzhi bskor gyi sngags dang / hūm̐ bai traka rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ rnam sras nang ma mo ltar bsgrub pa lha dgu'i sngags/ oṃ mahā rā dza sa ma ya bai shra ma ṇa ye sarba rat+na tsit+ta rat+na hriṃ dza dzaḥ rnam sras mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i sngags dang / na mo bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ dha na da ya swāhā/ na mo ra tha pa ri pū ra ya swāhā/ rnam sras dmar po las mkhan mdung dmar bcas pa'i sngags dang / oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ traka rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ rnam sras gsang ba gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa lha bcu gsum ma'i sngags dang / oṃ bai swāhā/ bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ oṃ dzam+bha la ye swāhā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swahā/ oṃ ku bhe ra ye swāhā/ oṃ sam̐ pra dz+nyā na ye swāhā/ oṃ gu h+ye na tha ye swāhā/ oṃ piñca ka ye swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye swāhā/ rnam sras ljang yul ma gser chen lha dgu'i sngags dang / oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ rnam sras ljang ser be con can gyi sngags te gtso 'khor de rnams kyi sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzlas/ de nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wa ra sngon du 'gro bas/ prok+ṣa ṇam̐ pra tits+tsa swāhā/ de bzhin du/ ar+gham̐/ pā d+yam̐/ añca mo nam̐/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+da'i bar rigs 'gre sbyar te mchod la rol chen bya/ dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ ma lus sems can la 'dur gdangs tal ma mdzad/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi bstod pa rgyal po'i thugs rab tu mnyes par byed pa zhes bya ba rnam sras bstod chen du grags pa'i nang nas 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul du bstan pa'i sgo nas bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ khyod ni byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang / /lha mi'i rgud pa ma lus bsal ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten skyong mdzad gnod sbyin chen por sprul/

/sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi rgyal po khyod ni rnam snang mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs las sprul pa ste/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa ji bzhin mdzad do zhes/ /phyag na rdo rjes yang dag shes la bshad/ /de phyir bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /mthu stobs thogs pa med pas bstan pa srung / /thugs rje chen pos bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong / /sangs rgyas rnam sprul khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul ni gong du bshams pa'i gtor ma rnams chu gtsang mas bran 'khyil pas bsang / swa bhā wa sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du kham̐ las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams rim pa bzhin du brtsegs pa/ de la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas/ yi ge gsum zhu nas nyes skyon thams cad dag par gyur/ a ka ros bdud rtsir bsgyur/ oṃ ru ru phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa gtor sngags 'di thams cad lan gsum re/ dpon slob mang po yod na bsgrigs 'don mdzad/ sarba ar+tha sa dha na ye swāhā dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas chen por spel/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ 'khyil pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ bai shra wa ra sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+na tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes lnga'am bdun/ oṃ dzam+bha la ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/

ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ ku bhe ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ sam̐ pra dz+nyā na ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ gu h+yai thā na ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ piñca ka ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes pa rta bdag brgyad/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa mahā nā ga ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes pas klu chen brgyad/ oṃ mahā sa na pa ti aṣ+ṭa biṃ sha ta ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes pas sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ oṃ mahā ba la twa tiṃ ṣaṭa i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba kar+ya sā dha a mo gha swāhā/ zhes pas stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis rnams la 'bul/ bsdu na thams cad la/ a ka ros phul kyang chog par bshad pas rnam thos kyi rigs gtso 'khor ji snyed pa thams cad la phul bar bsam sti/ a ka ros gtor sngags bsgrigs 'don rnams grub pa dang bsgrigs 'don med par a ka ro nyer gcig tsam gyis rnam sras kyi rigs thams cad la 'bul ba mdzad/ sngags lan nyer gcig tsam brjod la/ de nas dkar dung nas 'dra gsum dang rol mo chems brdungs kyi gcam la/ gsum brdeg lan can byas la/

rnga brdungs dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ rin chen 'di la tshigs bcad gcig la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang / gzhan rnams la 'dur gdangs mdzad/ pho brang dam pa nas/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal gsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams/ /sku ni gser gyi 'od bas mdzes/ /zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs/ /thugs rjes 'phongs pa las sgrol mdzad/ /sku la rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /byang phyogs rgyal por sku yang sprul/ /rnam thos sras zhes mtshan yang grags/ /gter bdag khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu la rin chen cod pan gsol/ /yon tan rdzogs la༞ gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /sde bo che la༞ gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/ /stobs po che la༞ bum pa bzang pos rnam par brgyan/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing / /rdzing bu bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dzam+bha la ni gser gyi mdog /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon na ne'u le g.yas pa na/ /rin chen bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang ba bzang po sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul༞ g.yon na༞ bum pa༞ nor bu bzang po sku mdog dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul༞ g.yon na༞ nor bu༞ ku bhe ra ni sku mdog nag /rdzu 'phrul༞ g.yon na༞ ral gri༞ yang dag shes ni sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul༞ g.yon na༞ gser gri༞ 'brog gnas sku mdog nag po la/ /rdzu 'phrul༞ g.yon na༞ mdung dmar༞ lnga rtsen sku mdog ser skya la/ /rdzu 'phrul༞ g.yon na༞ khang brtsegs༞ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul༞ g.yon na༞ gri phub༞ gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyi 'khor/ /mdog mi sdug pa sna tshogs te/ /g.yon pa thams cad ne'u le bsnams/ /g.yas na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/

/gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ /khams gsum thams cad dbang du sdud/ /khyod ni gter bdag chen po ste/ /nor bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di la gsum brdeg lan can mdzad/ ces pas bstod/ 'di la 'dur gdangs dang / mjug tu gsum brdeg lan can mdzad/ hūm̐ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes nas kyang / /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /bu sdug bzhin du skyong bar mdzad du gsol/ /skabs 'dir rol mo gsum brdegs lan can mdzad/ bdag la 'di yang 'dur gdangs mdzad/ gnod par sems pa yi/ /log par zhugs pa'i sems can rnams/ /de yi ru ma gzhom pa dang / /gtan nas brlags pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che mnga' ba'i/ /gnod sbyin bdag po khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam pa ma lus pa/ /myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas 'phrin las bcol/ de nas skabs 'dir bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i bstod chen gyi bshags pa'i le'u nas 'byung ba'i tshig lhug pa'i bshags pa 'di bzhin dpon slob rnams kyis bsgrigs 'don dang bcas rten rnams la me tog 'thor bzhin pa'i ngang nas bya ste/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras dang / de'i sras dang btsun mor bcas pa dang / blon po chen po rta bdag brgyad dang / sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drug dang / yul 'khor skyong ba'i gnod sbyin 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis nyan thos kyi theg pa'i sgor zhugs te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba ci bgyis pa thams cad nyan thos chen po khyed kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sgor zhugs nas/

byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba thams cad byang chub sems dpa' chen po khyed kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po khyed kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /khyad par du rgyal po chen po khyed la bka' sdod du gsol cing skyabs su song nas/ khyed kyi bka' dang dam tshig las 'das te/ spyi'i dam tshig gsum ma bsrungs pa dang / khyad par gyi dam tshig bzhi dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang / 'jig rten ngo srung gi dbang gis snod ma yin pa la chos bstan pa dang / khyad par rgyal po'i bka' lung sbyin mi 'os pa la byin pa dang / rang 'dod kyi dbang gis 'phrin las zhu bar mi 'os pa zhus pa dang / le lo'i dbang gis bzlas bsgom chag pa dang / ser sna'i dbang gis mchod pa dang gtor ma chag cing ngan pa dang / dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dang 'grogs pa la sogs rgyal po chen po'i thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /dmigs med chos sku'i ngang du bzod par bzhes nas bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ spros pa mi mnga' chos sku'i ngang nyid las/ /snyan bsrings mi mnga' kun tu gsan pa'i snyan/ /sgrib pa mi mnga' thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /thog med dus nas nyon mongs las dbang gis/ /bag med stobs kyis nyes pa gang bgyis pa/ /skye med chos sku'i ngang du so sor bshag /sprin med nam mkha' lta bur dag gyur cig /khyad par khyod kyi dam tshig las 'das te/ /bag med 'chol pas thugs dam ma bskangs pa/ /bde chen longs sku'i gnas su so sor bshag /mkha' la na bun yal ba ltar gyur cig /dam nyams tshig 'dres 'chol par spyod dang 'grogs/ /dam nyams grib mas phog pa'i nyes pa gang /

/cir snang sprul sku'i ngang du so sor bshag /bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin zhi gyur cig /ces lan gcig gam gsum la sogs pa bya/ de nas dkar dung nas 'dra gsum dang bcas rol mo gcam la gsum brdeg lan can bya zhing / rnga brdungs 'dur gdangs dang bcas/ bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa'i le'u 'di nyid bya ste/ mgon po 'di'i tshigs bcad dang po gsum dang / de nas tshigs bcad bzhi/ de nas tshigs bcad lnga rnams la mgon po'i chos nyid ma'i mchod dbyangs bcug nas mtshams rnams su rol mo gsum brdeg lan can re mdzad/ gnas srung 'khor bcas la/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin las byung ba'i/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos/ /mar me dri bzang zhal zas mchog /zag med bde bskyed nyer spyod rnams/ /'jig rten mtha' dag bkang nas 'bul/ /pi waṃ gling bu zangs dung dang / /dung dang rdza rnga rnga bo che/ /rol mo'i khyad par stong phrag bcu/ /snyan pa'i sgra yis rab tu mchod/ /dge ba'i stobs las 'khrungs pa yi/ /dpag bsam shing las byung gyur pa/ /lha rdzas yo byad ma lus rnams/ /blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi/ /mi dbang bsod nams mthu las byung / /'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun/ /rgyal po 'gran zla med byed pa'ang / /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /lha mi'i dpal ni 'phel byed cing / /don kun 'grub par byed pa'i rdzas/ /gdugs sogs bkra shis brgyad po yang / /gnas srung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /gya nom phul byung 'jig rten khams/ /bkang nas gnas srung 'khor bcas kyi/ /dbang po lnga rnams tshim phyir 'bul/ /ral gri la sogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /mkha' spyod la sogs dngos grub gter/ /grub pa nyi shu rtsa bdun yang / /rgyal chen thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir 'bul/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang /

/gsang sngags rigs sngags mthu stobs dang / /chos dbyings rnam dag byin rlabs kyis/ /gtor ma 'di ni lha rdzas kyi/ /bdud rtsi la sogs longs spyod tshogs/ /zag med bde ba bskyed nus pa/ /ngal gsos 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /nam mkha' gang ba 'byung gyur cig /khyed la bkres skom mi mnga' yang / /zag med bde ba rgyas pa'i rgyur/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag don slad du/ /dmigs med tshul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /lha min g.yul las rgyal byed pa'i/ /nor bu'i tog 'bar ba dan g.yo/ /rgyal mtshan 'di 'bul bdud dpung gi /dgra las rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ /skabs 'dir rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ rin chen bdun 'di'i tshigs bcad gcig la phur pa'i sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs ring rol mo dang bcas pa mdzad/ las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / /bkod legs dbyibs mdzes sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /lcang lo can mtshungs sprul pa'i khang brtsegs 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i gnas su 'bul/ /'di man la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung / phyi nang dar zab bar du sprin bal can/ /gong thong stod chod rab mdzes rin chen gyi/ /srad bus zung btab snam dkris sub mas bskor/ /ber chen bzang 'di rgyal po'i na bzar 'bul/ rol mo gsum brdeg lan can/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar sngo zhing mdzes/ /nyi zla lta bu'i mig 'bur mtho la rgyas/ /phum phum yid 'ong char sprin lta bus gtims/ /na bun lta bu'i ze rngog rab gzhol zhing / /char chu'i rgyun ltar rnga ma'i rgyun ring la/ /bar snang lta bur rkang lag khor yangs shing / /glog phreng lta bu'i rmig bzhi rab 'khyug pa/ /cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang lta bu'i rta/ /glang po'i dbang po lta bur nyams stobs ldan/ /mkha' lding lta bur rtsol med goms pa'i shugs/ /rtsol bas chung 'bring rab tu cher bgrod pa'i/ /'grongs sar 'gam dang bang gis myur bar bgrod/

/mgyogs tshad 'gro ba mi mngon lta bur ldan/ /rta mchog rin chen lta bu 'di dang ni/ /dkar ser dmar dang mtshal lu zhur po dang / /ngang pa 'ol ba la sogs sna tshogs pa'i/ /rta mchog gser gyi er khas mgrin par spras/ /srab 'jam yang la mdzes pa'i sha stan dang / /ar mo li ga'i thags le stan du bstad/ /rin chen shel la gser gyis spras pa'i sga/ /gser la dngul gyis spras pa'i sga lag can/ /rin chen karke ta na'i yob stan la/ /in+d+ra ni la'i yob chen mdzes pa can/ /pad+ma rā ga'i 'breng dmar mdzes pa la/ /rin chen margad rgyun gyis shar bu btab/ /gong thag smad chen smad chung rab sgeg cing / /baiḍūr+ya yi glo thag mdzes pa 'di/ /rdo rje pha lam pho long dam pos bsdams/ /rin chen bdun gyis kun nas spud pa yi/ /srab mgo kha lo bsgyur ba'i srab skyogs dang / /mu tig 'bur gyis bsdams pa'i thur mgo bcings/ /lha rdzas dar gyis byas pa'i thur mda' dang / /myur du skul byed shel gyi lcag 'bras can/ /rta mchog rgyan dang chas kyis spras 'di rnams/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /mgon po bzhon pas 'phongs pa mi mnga' yang / /bdag sogs bstan 'dzin rnams kyi don slad bzhes/ /phyogs bcur 'phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub tu gsol/ /bsod nams stobs las grub pa'i 'dod 'jo ba/ /yid la ci bsam nu ma las 'byung ba/ /mdzes shing yid 'ongs don kun 'grub pa 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ / 'dir rol mo gsum brdeg lan can dang / yang sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang bcas/ de bzhin yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /bum bzang ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog dang / /khrus rdzing sman ljongs skyed mos tshal la sogs/ /mchod rdzas yid 'ongs thams cad dbul bar bgyi/ /rmig bzhi rab brtan rwa ni rno la ring / /rtsid pa'i gzhon ring rnga ma kun tu g.yo/ /dar gyi phud bus mdzes par brgyan pa yi/

/gzhol chen g.yag 'di khyed la dbul bar bgyi/ /dkar la 'jam pa'i spu yi gos gyon zhing / /'khyil pa'i rwa la chu ris mdzes par brgyan/ /gnas can rnams kyi 'dod pa'i don bsgrub pa'i/ /lug gi khyu 'di khyed kyi 'brog tu 'bul/ / yang rol mo sngar bzhin gdangs dang bcas pa/ gangs ri ltar dkar bcu drug gling can rmog /srab mdzes byang bu rin chen rgyun gyis sbrel/ /sra brtan yab dang bcas pa'i khrab 'di dang / /phub gzhol spangs leb bcas pa'i go 'di 'bul/ /rin chen rgyu la mkhas pas rab sbyangs shing / /rno ngar rtsal dang ldan pa'i ral gri 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /bstan pa'i dgra rnams gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol/ /gser dngul gos dar ja ras stag gzig dang / /snam bu sha mar ka ra bu ram sogs/ /spyan gzigs yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyang / /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /mgon po khyed la 'phongs pa mi mnga' yang / /bdag sogs sems can rnams kyi don slad du/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i 'dod don bsgrub pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas zhwa gyon cing bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshig 'di rnams brjod do/ /gang thugs sgrib 'dur gdangs dang bcas/ gnyis las grol cing / /ji lta ji snyed kun mkhyen nas/ /thugs rje chen pos gnod sbyin gyi/ /skur sprul rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /btsun mo sras kyi tshogs dang bcas/ /khyad par gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad/ /sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /stobs po che ni sum cu gnyis/ /ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drug dang / /yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya dang / /'phrog ma bu bcas srin mo bdun/ /ma mo brgyad dang klu brgyad dang / /sna tshogs gzugs can gnod sbyin dang / /srin po sha za pho nya dang /

/bran dang g.yog tu bcas pa kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /khyed sngon ston pa'i spyan snga ru/ /dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi/ /bsrung zhing skyobs par zhal bzhes shing / /dam bca' brtan po gang mdzad pa/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' dgongs mdzad nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin gyi/ /dge 'dun sde dang bcas pa dang / /bstan pa mchod pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ /'jigs dang sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /las dang nyon mongs sdig pa kun/ /nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngon gyi las sam 'phral rkyen las/ /gyur pa'i 'jigs dang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /sdang byed dgra yi dmag tshogs dang / /chom rkun gdol pas gtses pa dang / /lus srog nor la gnod byed pa'i/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang rims/ /bgegs rigs brgyad khri gdon chen rnams/ /thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /glo bur ye 'brog gnod pa dang / /byad stems mthu dang 'byung ba 'khrugs/ /mi dang mi min gnod pa rnams/ /thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /phyi nang lus sems sdug bsngal kun/ /rang gi las las 'byung mod kyang / /dbang bcu brnyes pa khyod kyi mthus/ /bde ba'i las 'bras gsos btab cing / /sdug bsngal las 'bras zil mnan te/ /bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /lus sems sdug bsngal kun skyobs shig /las nyon zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /khyod sngon ston pa'i spyan snga ru/ /sems can dbul 'phongs bsal ba dang / /tshe srog rgud pa las bskyab phyir/ /bu sdug bzhin du bskyang ngo zhes/ /dam bcas gang yin de dgongs la/ /bdag cag dpon slob grogs mched sogs/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi/ /bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /skabs 'dir rol mo gsum brdeg lan can byed/ dus min 'chi ba'i dgra las rnam rgyal te/ /lus stobs kha dog zo mdog rab rgyas shing / /dam chos spyod pa'i lus ni ring du 'tsho/

/tshe la gnod med rab tu rgyas par mdzod/ /khyod ni nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas/ /bdag sogs bstan pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi/ /log 'tsho med cing chos dang mthun pa yi/ /longs spyod 'byor ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /'gro ba kun gyi phan bde'i rgyur gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen sgron ma 'di/ /nag phyogs bdud kyi dbang du mi 'gyur ba/ /rgyun du dar zhing rgyas pa mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag thams cad kyang / /chos min spangs shing dge ba'i blo gros rgyas/ /chos mthun 'khor dang dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /bshad sgrub chos kyi bya ba rgyas par mdzod/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams thams cad kyang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams kun bral nas/ /dge ba'i longs spyod thams cad phun tshogs shing / /bde skyid dpal 'byor kun nas rgyas par mdzod/ /khyod sngon rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gang du rgyal chen dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa de/ /rgyal po ma yin rgyal por 'gyur ba dang / /yin na chen por 'gyur phyir brtson bya zhes/ /thugs dam dam bcas gang yin de dgongs la/ /bdag sogs bstan pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa'i bya ba yun du 'grub pa'i phyir/ /thams cad chos kyi dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje ldan pa yi/ /bstan pa 'dzin nus gang zag thams cad kyang / /zab rgyas chos kyi snod du rung ba'i phyir/ /chos bzhin dbang du 'du ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dad pa dman zhing dge ba'i blo gros dman/ /chos la 'jug pa'i skal ba chung ba rnams/ /rgya chen chos kyi lam la sbyor ba'i phyir/ /thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /ma dad mi srun gtum pa'i las byed cing / /rnam pa kun tu 'gro la gnod pa byed/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig byed de rnams kyi/ /ma rungs sdig pa'i sems ni rab bcom nas/ /bstan dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag la/

/dad cing gus pa'i dbang gis 'dud gyur te/ /chos min spangs shing chos dang mthun pa yi/ /bya ba kun la sbyar bar mdzad du gsol/ /gnod sems can gyi mi min 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gnod sems spangs shing dge ba'i sems dang ldan/ /bstan pa srung phyir bdag gis ci bsgo ba/ /nyan cing bsgrub phyir dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /rdo rje 'chang chen phyag na rdo rje dang / /spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje kun tu bzang / /'gro bzang snying po rin chen rdo rje dang / /kha che dgon pa zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ /g.yor po jo ston bsod nams rin chen dang / /pad+ma bkra shis brtag pa jo bzang dang / /byams pa lo tsā bsod nams dbang phyug dang / /bsod nams seng ge rin chen seng ge ste/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma de rnams kyis/ /bsten bsten bsgrubs bsgrubs gsol gsol mchod mchod pa/ /bka' dang dam la btags pa'i dam tshig can/ /chos mdzad bu bzhin skyong ba'i thugs rje can/ /chos skyong chen po 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gces par bsrung ba dang / /nag tshogs rtsad nas gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces brjod cing rol mo dgu brdungs gnyis sogs bya zhing / bzlog pa'i rnga stabs dang bcas/ bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i drag po'i 'phrin las bcol ba 'di yang bya ste/ sngon tshe 'dur gdangs dang bcas pa'am/ yang na mgon po'i bskang gso chos nyid ma'i bzlog pa'i mgo'i rol mo blangs la tshigs bcad gnyis la chos nyid ma'i bzlog pa'i gdangs 'jug pa mdzad/ ston pa'i zhal snga nas/ /lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i rkyen byung tshe/ /gcig tu sdongs la srungs shig ces/ /bka' bsgo khyod kyis khas blangs shing / /gzhan yang mdo rgyud 'dzin pa dang / /gnas pa'i gang zag gnas dang bcas/ /bsrung ba'i dam bca' dgongs par mdzod/ /da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir ni/

/mi rnams chos min spyod pa'i rgyus/ /mu ge yams nad lo nyes dang / /chom rkun 'khrug pa dar bar 'gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rten 'joms shing / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo rnams 'phrog /dge 'dun sde dang bcas pa 'joms/ /sems can mang po'i srog 'phrog cing / /chos pa rnams ni lhag par gtses/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal 'di 'dra la/ /khyed kyis srung skyob mi mdzad na/ /thugs rje chen po mi mnga' yis/ /mi dang mi min bdud dpung gis/ /'gro ba nyam thag byas pa dang / /bstan la gnod byed 'di 'dra ba/ /ye shes spyan gyis ma gzigs sam/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal smre sngags dang / /bstan 'dzin nyam thag nga ro yi/ /'o dod phyogs bcur 'bod pa 'di/ /sgrib med snyan gyis ma gsan nam/ /thogs med gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa dang / /thugs rjes skyob pa'i mthu yod na/ /sdug la gnod pa 'di 'dra ba/ /gzigs sam yal bar 'dor ram ci/ /thams cad las la rag las pas/ /sems can las dbang bcos dka' na/ /las min thog tu mi 'bab pas/ /thugs rjes srung skyob ci zhig 'tshal/ /'di 'dra'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /sems can sdug bsngal mi skyob cing / /bstan pa gces par mi srung na/ /sngon gyi dam bcas bsnyel lam ci/ /de bas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /gnod byed 'byung po gdon gyi tshogs/ /zhi bas mi thul ma rungs pa/ /drag pos tshar gcad dus la bab/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /sdig pa'i las las ldog pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje khros pa'i thabs kyis ni/ /drag pos tshar gcad dus la bab/ /de bas rgyal po chen po khyod/ /sras dang bcas shing blon por bcas/ /dmag dpon sde dang bcas rnams kyis/ /nag phyogs bdud dpung 'di choms shig /rgyal chen shing rta bcas pa na/ /lha mi'i yul du sgra chen grags/ /rgyal chen lam du chas pa na/ /dngos po thams cad 'bar bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' lha dang dri za dang / /sa steng gnod sbyin srin po dang /

/sa 'og klu dang lha min gyi/ /dmag tshogs 'jigs pas shin tu gang / /srin po 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs/ /de yi mdun na rab tu rgyug /mi ma yin pa'i gzugs rnams kyis/ /'jigs shing skrag pa skyed byed pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs can mi sdug pa/ /ri rab rtse mo sgul bar byed/ /me mdag char pa 'bebs par byed/ /zas su sha dang khrag bza' zhing / /las su gdug pa'i srog 'phrog byed/ /khyed la mthu dang rtsal yod kyang / /nag phyogs bdud kyi dpung 'di rnams/ /rtsad nas gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /khyod ni thugs rjes khros pa'i tshe/ /sku stod ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /mkha' lding bya khra 'ug pa dang / /kaṃ ka la sogs bya gcan spros/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i gdug pa can/ /thams cad bkug nas sa la phobs/ /rgyu lto phrol nas don snying phyungs/ /don snying dbang po'i tshogs rnams kun/ /gnod sbyin dbang po'i zhal du stobs/ /sha khrag keng rus ma lus par/ /bya gcan pho nyas rngam par gsol/ /sku sked ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /gnod sbyin srin po mi sdug gzugs/ /mgo brnyan sna tshogs lag pa na/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa spros/ /sa steng rgyu ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bstan pa 'jig par byed pa rnams/ /lcags kyus snying nas drangs nas ni/ /mgrin pa zhags pas chings la khug /yan lag mtshon chas dum bur gtubs/ /rgyu ma nang khrol thang la phob/ /don snying 'jigs byed zhal du stobs/ /sha khrag gnod sbyin tshogs rnams rol/ /sku smad ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /seng ge stag dang dom dang dred/ /sha ra bha sogs gcan gzan tshogs/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can dpag med spros/ /sa 'og rgyu ba'i gdug pa can/ /sa yi gting nas steng du drongs/ /pho nya gcan gzan tshogs rnams kyi/ /sha rus lhag ma med par rol/ /khyed kyi sras po stobs po che/ /dbang po zhes bya dgu bcu gcig /stobs dang rdzu 'phrul cher ldan rnams/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la bab/

/khyed kyi khyad par sras bzhi po/ /gnod sbyin bye ba drug cu yi/ /dmag sde dang bcas stobs ldan rnams/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la bab/ /khyed kyi phul du byung ba'i sras/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /sde che dpung che mthu che ba/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la bab/ /gnod sbyin dbang po gar mkhan mchog /tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la bab/ /blon po chen po rta bdag brgyad/ /sde dpon nyer brgyad stobs po che/ /so gnyis re re'ang bye ba yi/ /sde dang bcas shing g.yog dang bcas/ /ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drug dang / /yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya dang / /sde dang bcas shing dpung dang bcas/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la bab/ /srin mo che bdun bu dang bcas/ /ma mo brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /sde dang bcas shing g.yog dang bcas/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la bab/ /bstan pa'i dgra dpung gzhom pa'i phyir/ /lus la sra ba'i go cha gon/ /phyag tu rno ba'i mtshon cha thogs/ /dmag dpung skyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /'jigs pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur khye/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /de yi phru ma gzhom pa dang / /gtan nas brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /sde dang bcas shing dpung dang bcas/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes tshar bcad nas/ /kun nas kun tu gzhom par mdzod/ /ngan sems mdun gros nang nas bshigs/ /sra ba'i go cha lus las phrol/ /'debs pa'i mtshon cha rdul du bshigs/ /skyob pa'i lha dang 'bral bar gyis/ /grogs byed mdza' ba'i bshes dang phrol/ /las nyon ye shes me yis sregs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal stong bar mdzod/ /ces brjod cing rol mo chems brdungs dang bcas dkar dung drag tu 'bud drag po'i las kyi dmigs pa rgyas par bsgom zhing / de nas rol mo gsum brdeg lan can byas la/

rnga brdungs dbyangs dang bcas pas bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i thog mar rgyal po'i gnas la bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ gang thugs 'di la mgon po'i bstod pa gang thugs ma thung ba tshigs bcad gcig la 'jug pa mdzad/ gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis/ /nyon mongs gdug pa sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul/ /thugs rjes rab khros khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'di man la 'dur gdangs mdzad/ bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes dam bcas shing / /'jig rten skyong mdzad grags mthu rdzu 'phrul ldan/ /gnas srung khyed kyi yon tan cha tsam zhig /bdag gis rab tu dad pas brjod par bgyi/ /gnod sbyin dbang po'i pho brang lcang lo can/ /lha rnams kun gyi yid kyis bris pa bzhin/ /phyi ra mthon po dpag tshad bcu drug dpangs/ /ngos rer dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu ste/ /gser gyi rgyu la rin chen kun gyis spras/ /phyogs bzhi'i lcog ni re re dag la yang / /gnod sbyin rdo rje 'chang ba rab tu gnas/ /pho brang de la sgo bzhi btod pa ni/ /byang ni gser la dngul gyis spras pa'i sgo/ /shar ni dngul la gser gyis spras pa'i sgo/ /lho ni gser gyis spras pa'i baiḍūr+ya/ /nub ni shel la baiḍūr+ya yis spras/ /grong khyer nang na me tog rab rgyas pa'i/ /skyed tshal rin chen sna tshogs ljon shing can/ /bya phran sna tshogs snyan pa'i sgra 'byin la/ /sna tshogs spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /lam srang gser gyi rang bzhin g.yas g.yon du/ /sbrang rtsi'i chus gang rdzing bu pad+mas brgyan/ /spu sdug gos gyon chu bya skad snyan sgrog /gnod sbyin mo rnams rab tu 'jo sgeg pas/ /glu dang rol mo sna tshogs byed pas brgyan/ /de yi nang na gzhal med khang mdzes pa/ /rin chen bdun rgyu sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /sgo dang rta babs rin chen them skas dang / /rin chen snam bu dra ba dra phyed dang /

/shar bu mda' yab la sogs rgyan rnams kun/ /rin chen du mas grub cing shin tu mdzes/ /de yi dbus na chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas/ /bsil ba'i rdzing bu sbrang rtsi lta bu'i chus/ /gang zhing bya dang me tog mdzes pas brgyan/ /dri bsung ldan pa'i tsan+dan nags kyis bskor/ /pho brang kun nas dpag tshad drug cu pa/ /brtsegs ma dang po rin chen gser las grub/ /gnyis pa dngul dang gsum pa baiḍūr+ya/ /bzhi pa gtsang dang shel gyi rgyu las byung / /lnga pa mu tig dmar po drug pa ni/ /rdo rje'i snying po bdun pa pug las bgyis/ /brgyad pa rin chen bdun las grub pa la/ /rtse mo nyi zla nor bu'i tog gis spras/ /rin chen bzhi las grub pa'i ka ba ni/ /brgyad khri'i ka gdan ka gzhu phyi gdung sogs/ /sna tshogs rin chen spras pas rab mdzes pa/ /lha yi bud med stong phrag brgya dag kyang / /khang brtsegs re rer gnas shing rtsed 'jo byed/ /lha rdzas lhab lhub sna tshogs mchog dag ni/ /bla bre la sogs cha byad sna tshogs dang / /glu dang rol mo lha rdzas bdud rtsi yi/ /bza' btung 'dod yon sna tshogs 'byor ba yi/ /yon tan gzhal du med pa'i khang brtsegs mchog /sna tshogs bkod pa du mas rab mdzes pa/ /lha gnas bye bas bsgrun par mi nus pa'i/ /pho brang mchog tu bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i rgyal po gtso bo la bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ sprin med 'di'i tshigs bcad gcig la mgon po'i bstod pa gang thugs ma dbyangs ring rol mo ring ba dang bcas pa mdzad/ mkha' la nam mkha'i nor bu'i gzis/ /zla skar 'od rnams zil gyis mnan pa bzhin/ /khyed sku yon tan rgyas pa gser gyi mdog /gzi 'od 'bar bas lha min zil gyis gnon/ /'gro 'di man la 'dur gdangs mdzad/ ba kun la dgos 'dod char 'bebs pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i tog gis rab mdzes pa/

/'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog /g.yas pa'i phyag gis 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phongs pa kun skyob phyir/ /dgos 'dod sgrub byed nor bu sna tshogs pa/ /kha nas 'byin pa'i ne'u le g.yon pas 'dzin/ /ser sna spangs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /'gro ba kun gyi re 'dod bskang ba'i phyir/ /zhal nas sna tshogs nor gyi char ba 'bebs/ /sbyin pa mthar phyin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba nya ltar tshogs gnyis bzhin ras rgyas/ /pad dkar rgyas 'dra'i mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa/ /pad+ma'i tshal du nyi zer lhung ba ltar/ /'dzum zhal dgyes pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi shes mun sel nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i/ /thabs shes nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa/ /khyod kyi phrag gong g.yas g.yon mdzes par brgyan/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi rgyal po chen por dbang bskur ba'i/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i dbu rgyan prog zhu gsol/ /bdud las rnam rgyal dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs mdzes/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyan gong ut+pal mdzes pa'i me tog can/ /snyan shal lha rdzas las grub 'khyil pas brgyan/ /rin chen mgul rgyan mdzes pa'i se mo do/ /nor bu'i do shal 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po'i phyag dang zhabs la lha rdzas kyi/ /gdub bu rgyan cha sna tshogs phra bkod pa/ /ska rags 'og pas nor bu'i tshar tshar can/ /g.yer kha'i dra ba spras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan dpes spras pa'i gzi brjid mtshungs med sku/ /nyi zla bye ba'i gzi yang zil gnon cing / /yon tan rgyas pa'i na bza' ser khra yis/ /lhab lhub brjid pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni 'jigs med gdong lnga'i gdan steng na/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung rab tu brjid pas 'gying / /srid gsum mnga' mdzad gzi brjid mtha' yas sku/ /yon tan rab rdzogs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/khyed gsung yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhir ldan/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la dbang bsgyur zhing / /khyod kyis sngags kyi las nyon sgrib pa 'joms/ /'dod dgu sbyin pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod thugs gnyis med ye shes me dpung gis/ /lta ba ngan pa'i tshang tshing kun bsreg cing / /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gtan nas skem mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes rgyas pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir rol mo gsum brdeg lan can/ cho ga bsdus pa'i tshe 'di yan chad mdzad/ /lha 'dur gdangs mdzad/ chen mang du thos pa'i drang srong gi /spyod pa'i dka' thub mdzad cing gnas pa'i tshe/ /de dang lha mo dpal las khyed 'khrungs te/ /mtshan yang srid sgrub btags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rgyal chen bzhi sogs lha rnams kyis/ /srid gsum rgyal por dbang bskur lcang lo can/ /phul nas rnam mang thos pa'i sras zhes bstod/ /rnam thos sras su grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha min dgra can lha la 'thab pa'i tshe/ /khyod sku ri rab skyed par ngal gso ba'i/ /gzi brjid ma bzod ngal gso phyag 'tshal zhes/ /bstod pas ngal gsor grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgul phreng dmag gis lha gnas 'phrogs pa'i tshe/ /khyed sku gser gyi go bgos seng ge bzhon/ /lha gnas bsrung pas gnas bsrung phyag 'tshal zhes/ /bstod pas gnas bsrung grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab rgod dmag gis lha gnas 'phrogs pa'i tshe/ /khyod sku sngon po'i gzi brjid ma bzod par/ /lus ngan 'di 'dras bdag cag btul lo zhes/ /brjod pas lus ngan grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni thugs rje chags pa'i sku mdog dmar/ /phyag g.yas rin chen be con rab tu 'phyar/ /g.yon pa rin chen skyug pa'i ne'u le 'dzin/ /khams gsum dbang du bsdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'jigs seng ge pad+ma zla gdan la/ /brjid mdzes 'gyings pas bzhengs pa'i tshul du mdzad/ /rin chen dbu rgyan la sogs rgyan rnams kyis/

/mdzes par brgyan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi g.yon du las mkhan mdung dmar can/ /mdog dmar bse rmog bse khrab sku la gsol/ /phyag g.yas mdung dmar shel gyi mchod rten g.yon/ /srid gsum dbang du bsdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni dbul phongs sdug bsngal zhi ba'i phyir/ /sku mdog ljang ser zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /za 'og ber gsol dar tshon 'gying thod bcings/ /rin chen rgyan spras ral gri rgyal mtshan g.yas/ /g.yon pas par bu rin chen ne'u le 'dzin/ /rgyan chas spras pa'i ngang pa gser ldan chibs/ /'gro ba'i dbul phongs sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /zhi bar mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skabs 'dir rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ khyod 'dur gdangs mdzad/ ni gdug pa tshar gcod phyir/ /thugs rje chen pos rab khros pas/ /mthing nag gzi 'od 'bar ba'i sku/ /rab gtum khyod phyag la 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas rdo rjes rab mtshan pa'i/ /dbyug pa ba dan bcas pa 'phyar/ /srid gsum gdug pa ma lus rnams/ /'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon pa yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i/ /chos sku'i mchod rten thugs khar 'dzin/ /bde gshegs bstan pa gces pa ru/ /bsrung mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /rgya mtsho 'khrug cing lha min skrag /ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ sgra brjod pas/ /gnam lcags 'bebs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mche ba gtsigs pas gdug pa 'dul/ /spyan 'gyur skar mda' stong phrag ltung / /smin ma bskyod pas glog phreng 'khyug /khro gnyer bsdus la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phrag gong g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i gzis/ /srid gsum 'od kyis snang byed cing / /nag phyogs bdud kyi mun pa kun/ /'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa'i klu brgyad lus la brgyan/ /gdug pa'i kha rlangs rab 'phros pas/ /gdug pa can gyi srog 'phrog byed/ /gdug pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku stod ba spu'i bu ga nas/

/mkha' lding bya can pho nya 'gyed/ /sa bla'i gdug pa ma lus pa/ /'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku sked ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /gnod sbyin srin po pho nya 'gyed/ /sa steng gdug pa ma lus pa/ /'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku smad ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /stag sogs gcan gzan pho nya 'gyed/ /sa 'og gdug pa ma lus pa/ /'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i sras la bstod pa'i le'u'i dbu nas sh+lau ka gnyis kyi bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ gnod sbyin 'dir skabs tshigs bcad gnyis la skabs su gur drag gi nga ni ye nas sogs mtshams gcod kyi dbyangs 'khor gnyis rol mo dang bcas pa bcug pa'i mgo mjug gi rol mo chems brdungs gnyis dor ba mdzad/ rgyun par phal cher 'dur gdangs mdzad/ dbang po khyod kyi sras/ /thun mong stobs ldan dgu bcu gcig /khyad par bde chen ldan pa bzhi/ /phul byung 'phrin las bsgrub pa gsum/ /bla med mchog tu gyur pa gcig /mthu chen dpung che rdzu 'phrul che/ /yon tan dpag med ldan pa yi/ /sras kyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i 'khor la bstod pa'i le'u'i nang nas klu chen yan gyi bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ gsang ba'i 'dur gdang mdzad/ dbang po khyod kyi 'khor/ /khyad par blon chen rta bdag brgyad/ /phyogs skyong sde dpon nyi shu brgyad/ /chos spun stobs chen sum cu gnyis/ /nor ster ba yi klu chen brgyad/ /ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drug dang / /yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang / /srin mo che bdun bu 'khor bcas/ /ma mo chen mo brgyad po dang / /sna tshogs gzugs can srin mo dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin dbang po rmugs 'dzin ni/

/gser mdog phyag g.yas rin chen 'dzin/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa/ /shar phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang ba bzang po sku mdog ser/ /ci dgos nang nas 'byung ba yi/ /bum pa bzang po g.yas pas 'dzin/ /lho phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu bzang po zla rgyas mdog /phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /'gro ba'i re ba rdzogs mdzad pa/ /nub phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rta bdag chen po ku bhe ra/ /mthing nag khros pa ral gri 'dzin/ /dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa/ /byang phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid shes pa'i yang dag shes/ /shes rab gser gyi ral gri 'dzin/ /mi shes gcod mdzad sku mdog ser/ /me mtshams gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'brog gnas rab tu khros shing gnag /lha min bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa'i/ /mdung rnon mtshon cha g.yas pas 'dzin/ /bden bral gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyin mtshan cho lo lnga rtse ba'i/ /lnga rtsen ser skya rgyas pa yi/ /rigs bdag g.yas na khang brtsegs bsnams/ /rlung mtshams gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam po 'khyil pa dung gi mdog /shes rab go chas gzhan 'joms shing / /rang bsrung gri phub g.yas pas 'dzin/ /dbang ldan gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mi sdug brjid la rngam/ /sna tshogs rgyan can go cha bgos/ /rdzu 'phrul rta chibs g.yon pa na/ /ne'u le bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ /ring po mig bzang gang po dang / /ser skya rnams ni shar phyogs srung / /seng ge nye ba'i seng ge dang / /dung can dga' bo lho phyogs srung / /seng ge seng ge'i ral pa dang / /bla ma ser skya nub phyogs srung / /'dzin pa 'dzin dga' brtson skyong dang / /khyab 'jug rnams ni byang phyogs srung / /lnga spyod tshig lnga gser ri mnyam/ /ser can mtshams srung nor bu'i rigs/ /sa pa shin tu sa pa dang / /nag dang nyi nag glang po'i rigs/ /phyogs bzhir gnas shing sa steng srung /

/nyi zla me rlung ba glang rigs/ /mtshams bzhir gnas shing bar snang srung / /thams cad sku mdog dmar nag ste/ /cung zad khro zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /go cha rab bgos gri phub 'dzin/ /sde dpon rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po'i chos kyi spun gyur pa/ /dbang po zla ba chu lha dang / /ba ra dh+wa dza skye dgu'i bdag /dbang ldan tsan+dan 'dod pa'i gtso/ /mgrin ngan mgul ngan ba ḍi dang / /nor bu nor bu spyod gha rab/ /nye lnga po dang ri nyams dang / gser can gangs po seng ldang ba/ /g.yon phyogs lha dang ba glang skyong / /'brog gnas mi yi rgyal po dang / /rgyal ba'i khyu mchog tshig lnga ser/ /bzhin bzang ring po sna tshogs sde/ /'bras bu gsum pa mgul gsum pa/ /lcags mdung ring po dag dang ni/ /lha las byung ba'i ma ldan te/ /sa ga'i rigs te rdzu 'phrul can/ /ljang nag go cha la sogs bgos/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan pa'i/ /dmag dpon mdung dang ral gri 'dzin/ /phyogs bzhir gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdong can dbang po mtha' yas dang / /nor rgyas bu dang 'jog po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang / /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /stobs kyi rgyu rnams gdengs kas brjid/ /spyi gtsug rin chen 'bar bas spras/ /nor gyi char 'bebs drag po yi/ /lta zer ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas spro na bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i thog mar nyan thos lugs dang mthun par bstod pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ khyod 'dur gdang mdzad/ ni theg pa dman pa la/ /mos pa'i sems can don gyi phyir/ /nyan thos theg pa'i sgor zhugs te/ /'dir yang rol mo gsum brdeg lan can/ bstan skyong khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cho ga bsdus pa'i tshe 'di yan mdzad/ khyod 'dur gdangs mdzad/ sngon mkha' lding rgyal po ni/ /sgra snyan sgra chung spun gnyis kyis/ /klu rgyal dbugs dang dbugs chen gnyis/

/gtses shing rab tu skrag gyur nas/ /gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du bros/ /de nas sangs rgyas 'od srung la/ /skyabs song bslab pa'i gzhi mnos pas/ /mkha' lding 'jigs bral bag yangs 'khod/ /de nas mkha' lding gnyis kyis kyang / /rgyu rkyen dris pas dad pa rnyed/ /sangs rgyas 'od srung zhabs song zhing / /bslab pa'i gzhi rnams yang dag mnos/ /'chi khar shākya thub pa de/ /mnyes par byed cing skye kun tu/ /gtso bor 'gyur bar smon lam btab/ /de'i mthus thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /dbugs dang dbugs chen yul 'khor srung / /'phags skyes por gyur sgra snyan ni/ /mig mi bzang gyur sgra chung ni/ /rnam thos sras zhes bya bar 'gyur/ /thub dbang lhums su zhugs pa nas/ /bltams dang rol rtsed mdzad pa dang / /khab tu bzhugs pa'i dus dag tu'ang / /rtag tu bsrung zhing skyobs par mdzad/ /mngon par 'byung ba'i dus dag na'ang / /chibs nas btegs te gdan drangs shing / /rab byung dka' ba spyod dus su/ /nyin dang mtshan du mel tshe byed/ /thub chen mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /bsod snyoms len par bzhed pa'i tshe/ /khyod kyis rdo yi lhung bzed bzhi/ /grogs la bgos te gcig car phul/ /ston pas gcig tu byin brlabs nas/ /nga la lhung bzed phul ba yis/ /rgyal chen chos kyi snod 'gyur zhes/ /lung bstan thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bzung ste ston pa dang / /dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi/ /mchod dang bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar byed/ /nam zhig thub pa'i dbang po ni/ /dal gyis 'bab kyi mtsho 'gram du/ /'phags pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dbus/ /gdan gyi gung la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /khyed sogs rgyal chen sde bzhi po/ /stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang bcas/ /so so'i phyogs nas lhags nas ni/ /mchod pas mchod de 'khod pa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gcig gis/ /so so'i skad du chos bstan pas/

/bzhi kas chos la chos kyi mig /rdul dang bral ba skyes gyur nas/ /bdag cag zhugs zhes ched du brjod/ /skyabs 'gro bslab pa'i gzhi bzung nas/ /de ltar thogs kyang lan bdun gyi/ /srid mthar phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bzung ste dam pa'i chos/ /bzung zhing bsrung bar khas blangs shing / /'khor bzhi skyobs par zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bstan srung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa mya ngan 'das pa'i tshe/ /ka ye lha yi dbang po dag /nga ni myur du mya ngan 'da'/ /de 'og khyod kyis bstan pa srungs/ /bstan pa nub tu nye ba'i tshe/ /'jig rten chos min shas cher spyod/ /mu ge rims nad 'khrug pa dar/ /dge slong rnams kyang bslab pa g.yel/ /de tshe ma rungs mi rnams kyis/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten 'jig /dge 'dun dag kyang gsod par byed/ /bstan la gnod chen 'byung ba'i tshe/ /khyed bzhi gcig tu bsdebs nas ni/ /bstan pa gces par srungs shigs zhes/ /ston pas zhal chems bzhag nas ni/ /bstan pa bsrung bar bskos pa bzhin/ /khyed kyang lha yi tshig bden pas/ /lnga brgya tha ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /bstan pa gces par bsrung ngo zhes/ /zhal gyis bzhes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/ de nas bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i tshul du bstod pa 'di nyid bya ste/ khyod ni byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dman mos sems can don gyi phyir/ /nyan thos 'phags par tshul ston pa'i/ /sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cho ga bsdus pa'i tshe 'di man mdzad/ khyod sngon bskal ba grangs med nas/ /byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing / /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad/ /'phags mchog brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la/ /rnam sras bden pa'i zla bar gyur/ /rin chen bdun las byas pa'i gdugs/ /thub dbang la phul 'di skad gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs las bdag nyid kyis/

/chos kyi rnam grangs gzung bar bgyi/ /pha rol la yang bstan par bgyi/ /bdag gi bsam pa de 'dra'o/ /sangs rgyas dpag med skyobs pa la/ /bdag gis gdugs 'di phul ba yis/ /bdag ni thub pa khyod 'dra bar/ /spyi gtsug bltar yang mi gdar 'gyur/ /zhes pa la sogs smon lam btab/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i nus mthu yis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mngon sum du/ /khyod la 'di skad lung bstan mdzad/ /khyod ni 'di nas shi 'phos nas/ /dga' ldan du yang skye bar 'gyur/ /dga' ldan gnas nas shi 'phos nas/ /sangs rgyas byams pa la sogs pa/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /mthong zhing kun la mchod byas nas/ /bskal pa stong phrag nyi shur ni/ /mchod pa byas nas rab byung ste/ /tshangs par spyod pa rab spyad nas/ /bskal pa bye ba drug cu na/ /khyod ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing gis legs brgyan pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gdugs/ /zhes bya bar ni sangs rgya ste/ /'khor ni byang sems sha stag la/ /khyod ni chos rnams ston par 'gyur/ /tshe yi tshad ni bskal pa gcig /dam chos bskal pa phyed du gnas/ /zhes gsungs mngon sum lung bstan pa'i/ /sa brgyad brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni bstan pa gzung ba'i phyir/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dam pa'i chos/ /zab mo gang dang gang gsungs pa/ /der ni khyed 'khor sde dang bcas/ /lhags nas gus pas nyan byed cing / /mdo sde 'di dang 'di 'dzin pa'i/ /gang zag bsrung zhing bskyab pa dang / /mdo sde gnas pa'i sa phyogs kyang / /yongs su bskyang zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ /gang du mdo sde 'chad pa der/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas dpung dang bcas/ /'ongs nas mchod cing bsrung ngo zhes/ /mdo sde phal cher gsungs pa'i tshe/ /ston pa'i spyan sngar mngon sum du/ /btags pa'i ngag gis dam bcas pa'i/ /chos skyong chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can bya/

de nas bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i sgo nas bstod pa 'di yang bya ste/ 'dur gdangs mdzad/ khyod ni rdo rje theg pa ma lus kyi/ /sgor zhugs bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang bskur te/ /rgyud sde ma lus bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /bstan srung chen po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rol mo gsum brdeg lan can mdzad/ cho ga bsdus pa'i tshe 'di yan chad mdzad/ khyed ni 'dur gdang mdzad/ gtsang ma'i gnas kyi 'og min du/ /'jam dpal rnam 'phrul rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur rgyud bshad bstan pa bsrung ba ru/ /bka' bsgos zhal gyis bzhes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin bde gshegs rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /phal cher khyod bcug dbang bskur rgyud gtad nas/ /bka' bsgos dam bcas de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /rigs kyi rgyud sde 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni don zhags rnam grol dkyil 'khor la/ /sogs par dbang bskur rgyud gtad bka' bsgos te/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud sde ma lus pa/ /skyong bar byed pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni phyag rdor rigs mchog dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos te/ /rdo rje rigs kyi rgyud sde ma lus pa/ /skyong bar byed pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni nor bu'i rigs kyi bdag po ste/ /stong phrag sum cu nor gyi bdag pos bshad/ /khyod kyi pha yis kyang ni 'bum phrag bshad/ /de ltar nor bu bzang sogs nor rigs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor phal cher dbang bskur nor bu yi/ /rigs kyi bdag por bka' bsgos dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba kun gyi dbul ba sel ba yi/ /nor rigs rgyud sde 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni rigs mchog lnga rtsen dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa/ /rgyas pa'i rigs kyi rgyud sde thams cad kyang / /skyong bar byed pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/de ltar de bzhin gshegs la brten pa yis/ /'khyam po'i rigs kyang bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bya ba'i rigs kyi rgyud sde sgo drug po/ /bsrung zhing skyong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni dpal yon can gyi grong khyer du/ /phyag rdor dbang bskur rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor cher/ /bcug ste dbang bskur dbyug tho rdo rje can/ /lag tu gtad nas khri phrag 'khor dang bcas/ /bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos gnyer gtad nas/ /rdo rje rigs kyi rgyud sde skyong mdzad pa/ /de 'dzin byed pa'i gang zag bu bzhin bsrung / /spyod rgyud bstan pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni mi g.yo khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur rgyud sde bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud sde rnams/ /bsrung zhing skyong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan srung ste/ /de bzhin gshegs dang rdo rje pad+ma dang / /nor bu'i rigs dang rdo rje 'chang gi rigs/ /gces par bsrung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri rab rtse mor de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor chen por bcug ste dbang bskur cing / /ral gri gtad nas rdo rje 'jigs byed ces/ /mtshan btags te bzhin gshegs rigs bsrung bar bsgos/ /khyod ni chos dbyings gsung dbang dkyil 'khor du/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi par bcug ste dbang bskur nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud sde kun/ /skyong bar byed pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod sngon khams gsum rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor du/ /bcug ste dbang bskur rin chen cod pan dang / /dar dpyangs byin nas lag tu rdo rje dang / /dbyug pa gtad nas rdo rje 'jigs byed ces/ /gsang ba'i mtshan btags mdog sngo ro langs zhon/ /lus ngan mo yang rdo rje zhags pa gtad/ /rdo rje 'khyor mar mtshan gsol rdo rje yi/ /rigs kyi rgyud sde skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/

/khyod sngon gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pho brang du/ /dpal mchog dang po'i chos dang las rigs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor chen por sngar bzhin dbang bskur te/ /chos dang las rigs skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bcug ste sngar bzhin dbang bskur mtshan btags te/ /rdo rje 'chang rigs rgyud sde thams cad kyang / /bsrung zhing skyong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod sngon gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pho brang du/ /nor ster gnod sbyin mo yi dkyil 'khor du/ /bcug ste dngos grub ster bar bka' bsgos shing / /nor gyi char ba 'bebs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshin rje gshed sogs dkyil 'khor du/ /phyogs skyong bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos shing / /sgrub po skyong zhing bar chad kun sel ba'i/ /pha rgyud bstan pa skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje 'chang gis dbang bskur byin brlabs nas/ /gsang mtshan drag po chen por mtshan gsol te/ /ma rgyud bstan pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ /ma rgyud dkyil 'khor phal cher dbang bskur zhing / /tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod skyong bar bskos/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten du/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor cher/ /dbang bskur phyogs skyong bstan pa bsrung bar bskos/ /gnyis med rgyud sde skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg gi rjes su chems brdungs dang bcas rang gi 'dod pa'i 'phrin las bcol/ de nas rol mo che ba gnyis brdeg la/ srid zhi'i 'di la spro na mgon po'i gtor 'bul skabs bzhin gyi dbyangs byed na mgor rol mo chems brdung gi mjug che ba gnyis gyi rjes su gsum brdeg ring ba blangs la de nas dbyangs ring thung rol mo dang bcas pa mdzad/

rgyun par phal cher shar ma mdzad do/ dpal 'byor ma yongs grags bzhin dang / 'gro 'di'i tshigs bcad gnyis la srid zhi dpal 'byor ma'i/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs kyi gdangs thung rol mo dang bcas pa mdzad/ la phan bde ma lus bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /thub bstan skyon med yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin gang zag mchog rnams chos 'phel zhing / /chos kyi bar chad ma lus zhi bar shog /skyabs mchog rin chen gsum gyi bden pa dang / /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs dang / /chos nyid rnam dag bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par shog /ces brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg lan can byas la bzhag de nas tshogs 'khor yod na/ ci 'byor tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad rnams bshams la chu gtsang gis bran te/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bha was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ ces dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ gdangs dang bcas pas/ tshogs mchod ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal chen 'khor bcas la/ /dad pas phul bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /dpal 'byor nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur shog /ces brjod cing / phud bla ma yi dam chos skyong la phul/ bar nas dngos grub kyi bsam pas longs spyod/ lhag ma bsdus te/ oṃ skabs 'dir lhag ma bsdus pa la chang gis bran la phyir dor ba dang mnyam du rol mo chems brdungs dkar dung sogs med pa yun ji ltar ring ba byas la/ de nas rol mo che ba gnyis brdeg la bzhag go /lhag ma 'di bzhin bya bar yi ge rnying ma 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba bzhin 'dir yang bkod pa yin mod kyi rang lugs kyi lag len la rnam sras kyi skabs 'dir lhag ma'i cho ga 'di bzhin mi bya ste/

bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las/ nor lha sgo bsdam bya ba yin pas gtor ma'i lha la gshegs gsol mi byed/ gnod sbyin zhal dro'i tshogs 'khor la tshogs lhag mi bsdud pa phyag len yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /u tsi ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa ye swāhā/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad tshim par gyur cig ces brjod pas lhag ma bsngos la rol mo dang bcas pa phyir gtong ngo / /gang ltar yang cho ga rdzogs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs te zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs byas la/ rang phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /gnas srung chen po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang / dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /zhes sogs yongs grags bzhin brjod pas dge ba bsngo zhing / bla ma yi dam chos skyong nor lha'i bkra shis gang 'os kyi mthar rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya zhing / dga' ston rgya chen po la rol lo/ /de dag ni cho ga rgyas pa'i phyogs te/ de las cung zad bsdu na/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed phyag rdor bsgom pa/ mdun bskyed bskyed bstim/ mchod 'bul/ yan lag bdun pa bya ba/ bzlas pa/ gtor 'bul/ bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba/ bstod chen nas 'byung ba'i bshags pa mchod 'bul/ zhi drag gi 'phrin las bskul ba rnams sngar bzhin byas la/ bstod chen gyi gnas bstod dang / gtso bo'i thugs la bstod pa yan chad/ sras dang 'khor la bstod pa sngar bzhin dang / nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul dang / rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i sgo nas bstod pa rnams kyi dbu nas sh+lau ka re re rnams bya zhing / de nas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma nas rjes chog bkra shis kyi bar sngar bshad pa bzhin bya'o/

/de las kyang bsdu na/ bdag bskyed nas gtor 'bul man sngar bzhin byas la/ rin chen pho brang dam pa nas/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod pa dang / hūm̐ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /zhes sogs kyi 'phrin las bcol ba gnyis bzhag la/ bstod chen gyi bshags le/ mchod le/ zhi drag gi 'phrin las bskul ba rnams sngar bzhin byas la/ de nas gong du bzhag pa'i bstod pa dang 'phrin las bcol ba gnyis skabs 'dir byas la/ de nas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma man chad sngar bzhin byas pas don tshang ba nyid do/ /de ltar ngal gsos dge ba stobs po che/ /mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes byas sbyar/ /legs byas 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro kun gyis/ /sgrib kun byang nas 'di dang phyi ma'i don/ /yid la re ba ji bzhin kun 'grub ste/ /srid mthar bstan 'gro'i don mang 'grub par shog /bdag cag so skye rang stobs mthu bral yang / /rgyal chen 'khor bcas mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob tshe ring dbang po gsal/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can bgrod mdzod/ /ces rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi mchod pa'i cho ga 'di yang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhabs la yan lag mchog gis reg pa sa skya pa chos med snyoms las mkhan sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa'i drung du rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras rigs mi 'dra ba lnga phrag gsum gyi rjes gnang dang / de'i rgyud dang / man ngag gi tshogs rgya bod kyi yi ge tshad ldan po ti gcig tsam du longs pa'i lung dang zhal shes du ma phyag khrid dang bcas bka' drin nos pa la brten/
